target.build: Kris and title credits from #33–#34, plus party training menu from #36

limits: Experimental build: focused checks do not certify the full adventure or physical hardware.
Known Kris bag crop/contrast limitations remain; cumulative training changes do not resolve them.
Cross-build save compatibility and broader Nature-dependent mechanics are not certified.
Wiki reference datasets and cheats remain based on Alpha 2; they are not retargeted or newly certified for this build.
Browser UI/download, CI and deployment are separate publication checks, outside this native integrity report.
Each player supplies their own clean HeartGold USA dump, preferably from their original cartridge; no ROM or download source is provided.

claims.integrity: Clean HeartGold USA reconstructs the exact target with both the command-line patcher and the pinned web VCDIFF engine. Modified input and damaged patch are rejected by command-line hash validation.
claims.training_menu: Focused checks cover the More > Train route, selected party slots, cancellation and one confirmed HP-IV change.
claims.ordinary_save: The confirmed HP-IV change and all three party records and bag bytes were preserved by an ordinary in-game Save.
claims.cold_load: A fresh process loaded the actual saved file without an input savestate or cheats. The confirmed HP-IV 20 and HP 23/23, all three complete party records, saved Nature values and bag contents were preserved in this focused check.
